Cloverleaf routes, SOUTHCOM to Fort Lauderdale

Planned on real sidewalks and paths through the stops and gyms your game showed during the scan. Each hub has a cloverleaf and the densest plain loop (button under the map); ranked by the denser of the two (bold in the table). Each area's best hub is listed even when it is less dense.

Scanned 2026-11-01 with teleport hops 1.5 km apart over the whole triangle SOUTHCOM – South Beach – Fort Lauderdale (565 km²). Each map reply holds every map cell touching a ~709 m circle around the hop, and every one of the area's 6,227 cells was in an answered hop's reply (all 351 hops answered). Miami was re-checked with an empty game cache, which found 271 forts that had been missing.
